best_how: Your revenue per hour, weighted by your hours (20 h are added for everyone) and corrected for the time slot, against the other sellers of the shop.
collection_note: One title per month and per bonus. Crowns and trophies stay: the collection grows month after month.
contest_how_2: sold this month. The shop’s 1st takes the shop crown, the network’s 1st the network crown.
contest_rule: The number of pieces sold in the month. On a tie, fewer tickets wins.
cross_how: A ticket with 2 items or more. Beat the shop target: every level pays.
d_lpt_month: Your lines per ticket this month
day_target_line: Sales, the line: the daily target
earned_so_far: earned if the month ends like this
lb_empty: Nobody is ranked yet this month.
lb_empty_week: Nobody is ranked yet this week.
lb_note_cross: By share of tickets with 2 items or more, from

min_tickets: tickets at least in the month.
month_closed: month closed, paid in vouchers early next month
more_cross_sales: more cross-sales on the same tickets
more_pieces_network: more pieces for the network crown
more_pieces_shop: more pieces for the shop crown
no_sale_text: Your own bonuses (cross-sales, record, leaderboards) show up from your first ticket rung up under your name. The shop target and Google rating already count.
no_sale_title: No sales under your name this month
no_target: No target set for this month.
no_ticket_yet: No ticket in your name yet today.
not_harvested: This month’s tickets are not counted yet.
not_ranked_reason: No sale or no planned hour this month: no ranking.

of_your_tickets_have: of your tickets have 2 items or more

prorata: Shared pro rata of hours worked:

sales_note: €/h: your sales divided by your scheduled hours, this month by the hours already worked. Network: your rank by sales per hour among ranked sellers.
sales_sub: Sales per hour, rank in the network
shop_bonus_rule: The level reached at month end gives euros per hour worked.
shop_how: If the shop reaches its monthly target, every level gives you euros per hour worked.
target_note: The monthly target is the shop budget. It is read in the cockpit; nobody changes it during the month.
tickets_with_2: tickets with 2 items or more, out of
today_unavailable: Today’s counter could not be read.
twelve_note: Rank: among network sellers with at least ten tickets that week. The line: the shop target.
unavailable: Bonuses cannot be read right now. Try again in a moment.
up_to_if: if you go one step further everywhere
weeks_note: Your cross-sales, week by week, as a % of your tickets. The line: the shop target,
within_reach_steps: within reach, one more step on each bonus
you_are_queen: you are the queen of the network
upcoming_text: What you can earn. Counting starts on the first day of the month.

hint_cross: {n} more cross-sales to reach {s} %: one more item on every ticket
hint_target: The shop still needs {n} € of sales this month
all_won: Everything in play is won: keep the pace until the end of the month.
counters_start: Your counters start with your first tickets of the month: every sale counts.
hours_left_short: {h} h of shifts left this month
step1_line: A month with at least {n} tickets sets your record; you can beat it from the next month.
step2_line: The 1st tenth above sets the new record, the 2nd pays
step2_tickets: {n} more tickets for the month to count.

gp_rule_b2b: sales excl. VAT to business customers
gp_rule_ticket: your biggest receipt of the season, business customers excluded
gp_rule_croisees: share of your receipts with two items or more
gp_rule_progression: sales per hour vs the same months last year
gp_need_tickets: {n} more receipts to enter the ranking.
gp_need_hours: {n} more hours of work to enter the ranking.
